jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Speakeasy

AI is moving from chat interfaces to operational systems.

Across enterprises, AI agents are connecting to internal systems, using APIs, accessing data, and taking actions on behalf of employees. But while AI adoption is accelerating, governance, visibility, and control have not kept pace.

Speakeasy is building the Enterprise AI Control Plane.

We help organizations securely connect AI systems to their APIs, tools, and internal infrastructure while providing the identity, governance, permissions, auditability, and observability required to operate AI at scale.

Our customers include companies like Mistral, Verizon, Cisco, Vercel, Redis, Glean, LaunchDarkly, PlanetScale, and Docusign. We are backed by Google Ventures, FPV, and Quiet Capital. Today, hundreds of companies rely on Speakeasy infrastructure across API platforms, MCP deployments, and enterprise AI systems.

We’re a highly technical team based across San Francisco and London, building at the intersection of AI, infrastructure, security, developer platforms, and enterprise software.

The Role

Forward Deployed Engineers sit at the center of our customers, product, and engineering teams.

You will work directly with engineering leaders, platform teams, security teams, and AI initiatives at some of the most sophisticated companies deploying AI today.

This is not a traditional solutions engineering role. You’ll operate across pre-sales, deployment, product feedback, and engineering, acting as the technical bridge between our customers and our platform.

You will partner closely with customers from initial evaluation through production deployment. You’ll lead technical discovery, design integrations, solve architecture challenges, build proofs-of-concept, influence product direction, and help define how enterprises securely adopt AI agents and MCP infrastructure.

One week you may be helping a customer connect internal APIs to AI systems. The next week you may be designing access control models, debugging identity flows, implementing MCP governance, or working with our product team on entirely new capabilities driven by customer feedback.

You will often be the technical face of Speakeasy and one of the first people customers trust with mission-critical AI initiatives.

What You’ll Do

Drive Technical Sales

  • Partner with Account Executives on strategic customer opportunities

  • Lead technical discovery and architecture conversations with prospective customers

  • Design and deliver demos, proofs-of-concept, and pilot implementations

  • Help customers evaluate how Speakeasy fits into their AI, security, and infrastructure strategy

  • Translate customer requirements into deployment plans and product feedback

  • Serve as the technical owner for complex opportunities from evaluation through production rollout

Deploy and Integrate

  • Lead customer implementations of the Speakeasy AI Control Plane

  • Design integrations with APIs, MCP servers, SaaS platforms, identity providers, and internal systems

  • Build prototypes, proofs-of-concept, and deployment architectures

  • Troubleshoot complex technical issues across customer environments

Partner With Customers

  • Act as a trusted technical advisor to engineering, platform, security, and AI teams

  • Translate customer requirements into technical solutions

  • Guide customers through architecture decisions and implementation tradeoffs

  • Drive successful production rollouts and long-term adoption

  • Build strong relationships with engineering leaders, platform teams, security teams, and AI stakeholders

Shape the Product

  • Identify patterns across customer deployments

  • Influence product roadmap and prioritization

  • Work directly with engineering to improve platform capabilities

  • Create reusable deployment patterns, documentation, and best practices

Build

  • Write production-quality code when needed

  • Build internal tooling and deployment accelerators

  • Create reference implementations and demos

  • Prototype new product ideas alongside customers

Who You Are

Successful candidates often come from backgrounds such as:

  • Founding Engineer

  • Forward Deployed Engineer

  • Solutions Engineer

  • Platform Engineer

  • Infrastructure Engineer

  • Technical Founder

You are comfortable moving between code, architecture discussions, customer conversations, and product strategy.

We are particularly excited if you:

  • Have 5+ years of software engineering experience

  • Have built or deployed APIs, developer platforms, infrastructure products, or security systems

  • Have experience working directly with customers in technical environments

  • Can quickly understand unfamiliar systems and navigate ambiguity

  • Enjoy solving open-ended problems with incomplete information

  • Have strong communication skills and can explain complex technical concepts clearly

  • Care deeply about customer outcomes

Bonus Points

  • AI agent, MCP, or LLM application experience

  • Identity and access management experience

  • Security, governance, or compliance background

  • Experience with enterprise software deployments

  • Startup or founding-team experience

What Success Looks Like

Within your first 6 months, you will:

  • Become a trusted technical advisor to both prospective and existing customers

  • Independently lead technical evaluations, pilots, and enterprise deployments

  • Help customers securely deploy AI agents, MCP servers, and internal tools at scale

  • Identify product gaps and influence the roadmap through direct customer engagement

  • Establish best practices for enterprise AI governance and agent infrastructure

  • Drive meaningful customer outcomes that directly impact company growth and adoption

Why Speakeasy

We’re building infrastructure for one of the most important transitions happening in software.

As AI systems evolve from chat interfaces into operational agents, every company will need governance, visibility, identity, and control over how those systems interact with the world.

We believe the Enterprise AI Control Plane becomes a foundational layer of modern infrastructure.

Joining now means helping define that category from the beginning.

Compensation & Benefits

  • $180,000-$230,000 base salary + meaningful equity

  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage

  • 401(k)

  • Flexible PTO

  • Regular company offsites

  • Offices in San Francisco and London

  • Small team, high ownership, significant impact

jobs.title: Account Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Speakeasy

Speakeasy began in the developer tooling space by building a toolchain for powering API developer experience. With the rise of AI and since the launch of MCP, we have expanded into helping teams build, secure, observe, and distribute AI tools across their organization with the Speakeasy AI Control Plane.

Our customers today include leading tech companies and fortune 100 enterprises such as Mistral AI, Vercel, PlanetScale, Verizon, and Docusign.

We were founded in 2021 and have already hit important revenue milestones. We have raised funding from top-notch VC and angel investors who share our vision, and have significant runway remaining.

Our team is split between San Francisco and London, with offices in both locations. We work best together in person. This role is based in our San Francisco office four days a week, with one day remote. We meet up and spend a week together roughly every quarter.

About the role

As an Account Executive, you will drive adoption of our newest product, the Speakeasy AI Control Plane, and help shape the future of AI adoption, security, and governance across the enterprise. You'll own the full sales cycle from qualified opportunity through close. You'll work with mid-market and enterprise buyers navigating the shift to AI-native workflows, helping them understand how the Control Plane fits into their stack and securely accelerates AI rollout across their organization. You'll run discovery, lead demos, negotiate contracts, and close deals. But this isn't just a closing role. You'll partner closely with GTM, product, and marketing to sharpen how we position, what resonates, and where the market is moving. This is an early sales hire and you'll have a direct hand in building our playbook, not just running it. The ideal candidate is a self-starter and strong relationship builder who gets energy from learning a new market, building strategy around it, and identifying opportunities in a category that is not yet fully defined.

About you

  • 3–5+ years of full-cycle B2B SaaS sales experience, consistently meeting or exceeding quota

  • Experience selling technical, developer-adjacent or infrastructure products — you don't need to write code, but you can hold your own in a technical conversation

  • Strong discovery and qualification instincts — you lead with the customer's problem, not the pitch

  • Demonstrated ability to independently build and advance C-suite and SVP relationships, and manage multi-quarter sales cycles involving technical evaluations and enterprise procurement

  • Experience managing a pipeline of 15–30 active opportunities, excellent forecasting discipline and CRM hygiene

Who we’re looking for

Our ideal candidate:

  • High ownership and autonomy: you figure out what needs to happen and make it happen without waiting to be told.

  • Comfortable operating without a fully built playbook: the market, messaging, and process are still being shaped, and you see that as a feature, not a bug.

  • Naturally brings customer signal back to the business: You don't just close deals, you surface patterns from the field that sharpen how product, marketing, and leadership think about the market.

  • Respects how we operate and raises the bar: we are ambitious, passionate about what we do, and seek to be exceptional. If you are looking for a place to clock in and out, we are likely not a good fit for you.

Benefits

  • Salary ~ $250K OTE

  • Generous equity

  • Competitive pay

  • 100% employer-covered medical, dental, and vision insurance

  • 401(k) plan

  • Unlimited PTO

  • Lunch provided in office from some of the best restaurants in San Francisco!

  • Annual off-sites with the entire team (previous locations: 2024 - Lisbon, 2025 - Mexico City, 2026 - Madrid!)

  • Work with a fun, collaborative, ambitious team

Excited to learn more? Get in touch with us at jobs@speakeasyapi.dev. We look forward to hearing from you!

jobs.title: Product Engineer (Security) - AI Control Plane
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Speakeasy provides the AI control plane for enterprises.

We help companies securely scale usage of AI with a platform to centrally manage MCPs, Skills, and Assistants your whole company can use, with fine-grained permissions, threat detection, and full observability.

We are a fast growing venture backed team based out of San Francisco and London. We have a track record of building developer tools and infrastructure widely used from Fortune 500 to well known startups.

Working at Speakeasy as an engineer means being a product owner, collaborating closely with GTM and owning product decisions from inception to customer success. We care deeply about craft, quality and execution.

About the AI control plane

Our platform enables enterprises and fast-moving startups to get the most out of Claude, Codex, Cursor and other providers by

  • Leveraging enterprise identity systems to secure access to MCP servers

  • Securing agent sessions to ensure sensitive data and enterprise policies are respected.

  • Providing easy to use primitives to build new mcps, skills and assistants (secure claw)

  • Deeply understand AI usage within an organisation from tool use, token spend, and complete agent sessions.


About the Role

This is a unique, high-impact opportunity to join a passionate team about an intuitive craft to enable solving green field and hard product problems. You’ll be working on an early product with a fast moving team that’s done this before and collaborating with founders (and customers) directly on a daily basis.


You will collaborate closely with the rest of the product and engineering team to

  • Design and ship features that enforce enterprise security policies around MCP usage and access.

  • Improve and fine tune our risk policy system. This includes both deterministic and prompt based policies using LLM-as-a-judge techniques.

  • Deepen our integrations with identity providers and stay up to date on the latest developments in agent identity.

  • Collaborate on hardening our own security posture.

    You’re a good fit if...

  • You want to join a talent-dense team made up of ex-founders and domain experts across various developer tools, languages, and infrastructure (in fact over a quarter of the team).

  • Ownership excites you in the full lifecycle of development: building, shipping, running support, maintaining infrastructure and measuring impact.

  • You have shipped features on products used by security teams

  • You have an exceptional ability to learn, pickup new frameworks, and can work across the stack from backend to frontend.

  • Ability to participate in on-call rotation and respond to production incidents.

  • Ability to work in person in our San Francisco Office

You’ll be working on an early product with a fast moving team that’s done this before and collaborating with founders (and customers) directly on a daily basis. Some of the ways you will have impact: 

 - Identify architectural changes to improve reliability, performance and availability.

 - Foster a culture of reliability across Speakeasy's engineering organization.

 - Design and implement key operational processes such as deployments, upgrades, rollbacks, and postmortem review.

 - Join a core engineering team and participate in on-call rotation, responding to production incidents.

 - Build monitoring systems that ensure the highest quality service for our customers.

 - Debug production issues across all services and levels of the stack.
